note: Adapted from Mjöberg's 1920 original description (in English), original name Eutermes kimberleyensis n. sp.; includes the soldier and worker with measurements (partly mixing comma decimals and forms such as '1.48', uniformly transcribed here) and a nest description; type locality West Kimberley, Australia.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier close in size to that of E. fumipennis, but the head is pale reddish brown, broad and rounded behind, the sides distinctly narrowing towards the short, thick, slightly darker nasus, slightly concave in front, the nasus slightly constricted in front with straight sides; antennae distinctly 14-segmented, long and slender, pale yellow, the basal and terminal segments paler. Worker head pale reddish yellow, with a pale median line and an oblique transverse suture dividing the red area into two lateral fields and one anterior field.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: about the size of the soldier of E. fumipennis; head pale reddish brown, broad and rounded behind, the sides distinctly narrowing towards the short, thick, slightly darker nasus, slightly concave in front, the nasus slightly constricted in front with straight sides. Antennae distinctly 14-segmented, long and slender, pale yellow, paler at the base and tip; basal segment long and stout, segment 2 less than half the basal segment, segment 3 about the same size as segment 2, segment 4 much longer, segment 5 slightly shorter, segment 6 as large as segment 4, segments 7—13 gradually longer and about 3 times as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, raised in front into a dark ridge with a pale median line; legs very long and slender; abdominal tergites pale yellow; cerci thick, pale yellow. Measurements: body length 4 mm; head length 1.48 mm; nasus length 0.53 mm; nasus tip width 0.19 mm; head width 0.97 mm; pronotum length 0.29 mm, width 0.57 mm; abdominal width 0.87 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head pale reddish yellow, with a pale median line and an oblique transverse suture dividing the red area into two lateral fields and one anterior field; head rounded at the sides and behind, widest in front of the antennae. Base of the clypeus broad and convex, divided by a pale median line, whitish at the tip, projecting at the middle of the anterior margin as a blunt point; labrum broad, slightly rounded in front, the sides distinctly narrowing towards the base; mandibles stout and triangular with the usual tooth series of Eutermes, but the teeth often worn and irregular in shape; antennae whitish, 15-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4, the following segments about twice as long as wide, the terminal segment shorter than segment 14, elongate with a rounded tip. Pronotum raised in front into a ridge, concave in the middle; abdomen oval and rounded. Measurements: body length 6 mm; head length 1.62 mm; head width 1.54 mm; pronotum length 0.68 mm, width 0.8 mm; abdominal width 1.62 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Nest: a red nest built in open dry savanna woodland in West Kimberley, up to 2 m high, elongate and more or less columnar; the wall about 2 inches thick, of hard sandy material.
